title: Very good basic bread maker
text:
Very good basic bread maker. My very first bread maker was the similar-looking Cuisinart CBK-100, which was a faithful workhorse until the dough bucket fell apart out of warranty (and a replacement would have cost as much as a new bread maker).

I loved the various modes (sweet bread, gluten-free, jam, artisan, dough mode only) and used it several times a week.

So when I had the opportunity to review the Hamilton Beach Premium Dough & Bread Maker Machine with Auto Fruit and Nut Dispenser, 2 lb. Loaf Capacity, I was eager to get back into breadmaking. The Hamilton Beach offers three different loaf sizes (1, 1.5 and 2 pounds) and crust settings, 14 presets for bread, dough, jam and cake, automatic fruit and nut dispenser, and a dishwasher-safe pan. One feature I really liked not present on my other bread makers is the "rise" setting that is meant for use with frozen bread dough. I would have liked to see more sample recipes in the included booklet (I still have my older Cuisinart manual as it has about 40 recipes that all work like a charm sized for 1, 1.5 and 2-pound loaves!).

In looks and setup, it is very similar to the Cuisinart (including the viewing window on top). Do be very careful to always use oven mitts when handling the pan because it gets HOT (as does the outside of the machine; be sure not to push it up against a wall as the convection fan needs air to circulate).

Similar to my Cuisinart, though, I'm not thrilled about the baking performance (I prefer to use the machine on dough mode and finish baking in the oven) as I find bread machines tend to bake unevenly (and never get as crispy as I like for artisan doughs, which I always finish in the oven).

But for everyday use and for kneading and mixing doughs, the Hamilton Beach is more than up to the task and I look forward to experimenting with bread machine recipes from some of my other cookbooks.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Premium Dough & Bread Maker Machine with Auto Fruit and Nut Dispenser, 2 lb. Loaf Capacity, 14 Programmable Settings Including Gluten Free, Stainless Steel (29888)
features: Automatic fruit and nut dispenser: no need to wait around during the kneading process if you want to add mix ins to your dough – the bread maker machine features an automatic fruit and nut dispenser that will do it for you at the ideal time.
Fresh homemade bread in just 3 steps: just add your ingredients to the bread maker, select the cycle and press start.

14 programmed cycles: bread maker settings include: basic, French, sweet, 1. 5 lb. Express, 2 lb. Express, quick bread (no yeast), gluten free, artisan dough, whole grain, dough, rise, bake, jam and cake.
Customizable size and shade: choose from light, medium, or dark crust options and 1, 1. 5 or 2 lb. Loaf sizes.
Dishwasher safe parts: the bread machine pan and paddle are dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.
description: Become a master at made-from-scratch bread with minimal effort. The Hamilton Beach premium dough & bread maker lets you create fresh homemade breads and doughs without even having to roll up your sleeves to mix and knead. Just add ingredients, select the cycle and press start. The automatic fruit and nut dispenser will even integrate your mix-in ingredients into the dough at the ideal part of the kneading process for a truly hands-off experience. With 14 programmed settings for a variety of breads and doughs, you can make everything from gluten free loaves to sweet, gooey cinnamon Raisin buns. Customize your bread down to the size and shade with 3 loaf sizes and 3 crust shades. When it's time for cleanup, The bread pan and paddle can go safely in the dishwasher.
